Chidziwitso: imagwiritsa ntchito mutu ndi maudindo okha, osati nkhani zonse, kotero mayankho amakhala opanda tsatanetsatane.

webSearch.providerBingDescription: Imawerenga tsamba lonse kuti ipereke mwachidule mwatsatanetsatane ndikuphimba webusaiti yonse, osati nkhani zokha. Komabe, kusaka kumakhala pakati pa 30–90 masekondi ndipo khalidwe la zotsatira limasiyana pakati pa kusaka.
webSearch.sourcesDescription: Angati a gwero losiyana amene kusaka kumasunga ngati manenedwe. Mafunso ofuna kafukufuku angakulekanitse kwatomatiki.
webSearch.freshnessDescription: Kodi zotsatira ziyenera kukhala za nthawi yanji? Zokha zimapereka chisankho pa funso lililonse (nkhani zatsopano zimakonda tsiku laposachedwa).
webSearch.providerCombined: Kusaka kozama ndi mitu yoyamba (Bing + Google News)
webSearch.providerCombinedDescription: Imagwiritsa ntchito Bing grounding ndi Google News limodzi: mitu imawonekera mkati mwa masekondi pamene kusaka kwa Bing kukupitilira, ndipo mutha kusankha kuyankha kuchokera pa mitu yapezeka nthawi yomweyo osadikira kusaka kutha. Bing akamaliza, zotsatira zonse zimaphatikizidwa.
webSearch.providerBingResponsesDescription: Kufikira pa intaneti kwa Bing mofanana ndi Bing grounding, koma pogwiritsa ntchito model imodzi yokha osagwiritsa ntchito Foundry agent — nthawi zambiri imathamanga kwambiri. Njira yatsopano ikuyesedwa poyerekeza ndi Bing grounding.

gpt_4_1.description: Mtundu wa AI woyendetsedwa ndi GPT-4.1 wokhala ndi kusakira pa intaneti nthawi yeniyeni kudzera pa Bing. Yabwino kwambiri pa kafukufuku wofunikira zambiri zaposachedwa, kuwunikira nkhani, ndi kutsimikizira zoonadi.

gpt_5_2.name: GPT-5.2
gpt_5_2.description: Mtundu wapamwamba kwambiri wa OpenAI, womwe umapambana pa kuganiza kovuta, kupanga nambala, ndi kuthetsa mavuto aukatswiri. Wabwino kwambiri pa ntchito zowunikira, zovuta za kulemba nambala, kafukufuku, ndi mafotokozedwe athunthu. Umathandizira kulimbikira kwa kuganiza kosinthika ndi kutalikira kwa mayankho.

gpt_5_mini.name: GPT-5 Mini
gpt_5_mini.description: Mtundu wachangu kwambiri ndi wotchipa wa GPT-5, wokonzedwa kuti ukhale wachangu pomwe umapitiriza kukhala wabwino. Wabwino pa ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku, mafunso achangu, ndi mapulogalamu omwe amafunikira mayankho achangu. Kulingana kwabwino kwa ntchito ndi kuthekera.

gpt_5_2_chat.name: GPT-5.2 Chat
gpt_5_2_chat.description: Mtundu wapadera wa GPT-5.2 wokonzedwa kuti ugwiritsidwe ntchito pa kukambirana komanso kuzindikira m'maganizo. Umagwira bwino poyankhula mwachifundo, kulemba mwaluso, kupanga malingaliro atsopano, ndi kukambirana mwachilengedwe. Uli bwino pa zokambirana zosadetsa, thandizo la upangiri, komanso ntchito zofunikira kuzindikira maganizo a anthu.

o3.name: o3
o3.description: Mtundu wa kuganiza wapamwamba kwambiri wa OpenAI wokhala ndi maudindo othetsa mavuto apamwamba. Umapambana pa masamu ovuta, kuganiza kwasayansi, zovuta za kulemba nambala, ndi ntchito za kuganiza zamaphatikizidwe ambiri. Zenera lokulitsidwa la 200K. Umathandizira kuyang'anira kulimbikira kwa kuganiza.

llama_4_maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama_4_maverick.description: Mtundu wachangu ndi wotchipa kuchokera ku Meta. Wabwino pa ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku monga kulemba, kufotokoza mwachidule, ndi thandizo loyambirira la kulemba nambala. Kulingana kwabwino kwa liwiro ndi bwino pa ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku.

deepseek_r1.name: DeepSeek-R1
deepseek_r1.description: Katswiri wa kuganiza amene amaonetsera ntchito yake gawo ndi gawo. Wabwino kwambiri pa mavuto a masamu, mikuluwiko ya kuganiza, ndi kumvetsa maganizo ovuta. Onani mmene amaganizira pa mavuto nthawi yeniyeni.

• Zithunzi: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP (5MB mochuluka, mpaka 10)

settings.storageLocalConfirmTitle: Mukufuna kusunga macheza pa chipangizochi chokha?

settings.statusNotEncrypted: Siyinaotetezedwe—mafayilo a backup anu mu OneDrive amawerengeka

settings.encryptionPlainDescription: Macheza anu amasungidwa ngati mafayilo owerengeka mu OneDrive. Recovery key siyofunika.

settings.encryptionPlainConfirmMessage: Macheza anu asungidwa ngati mafayilo owerengeka mu OneDrive yanu. Aliyense amene ali ndi mwayi pa OneDrive yanu, kuphatikizapo IT administrators ndi ma app olumikizidwa, angathe kuwerenga. Recovery key yanu siyidzafunikanso.
settings.encryptionPlainSuccess: Backup yasungidwa ngati mafayilo owerengeka mu OneDrive yanu
settings.encryptionEncryptConfirmMessage: Kopi yanu ya OneDrive yowerengeka idzasinthidwa ndi yotetezedwa. Mudzapanga recovery key—mudzayifunika kuti mubwereretse macheza anu pa zipangizo zina.
settings.encryptionSwitchFailure: Sinaleke kusintha encryption setting—backup yanu yasala momwemo.
